## Spec-Driven Development checklist

- [ ] **Spec impact:** spec updated, or no behavior change (explain)
- [ ] **Plan status:** plan is approved for the current spec version
- [ ] **Linked criteria:** every changed behavior links to an AC-ID
- [ ] **Test coverage:** each linked criterion has a passing test that asserts the observable result
- [ ] **Manual behavior checked:** request or browser check recorded in the traceability table
- [ ] **Decisions:** any change of intent recorded in `.sdd/decisions.md`
- [ ] **No unrelated files changed:** no drive-by refactoring, dependency upgrades, or build changes
